steps: Go to the SAT portal (button below) and look for "Genera tu Constancia de Situación Fiscal".
Sign in with your RFC and your SAT password (CIEC), or your e.firma. That password stays on the SAT site — never share it with us.
Download your certificate as a PDF.
Come back here and upload it with the "Upload PDF" button.
Go to gob.mx/actas (button below).
Look up your birth certificate with your CURP.
Download the certified PDF.
Come back here and upload it with the "Upload PDF" button.
Have your current voter ID (INE) at hand.
Take a photo of the front on a table, in good light and without glare; every field must be readable.
Upload it with the button below and then add the back with “Upload back side”. You can also upload a PDF with both sides.
Go to gob.mx/curp (button below).
Enter your CURP or your details and download the PDF.
Come back here and upload it.
Scan or photograph the property deeds page by page, in good light.
If there are several pages, it's best to combine them into one PDF (a phone scanner app works).
Upload it here. If it's larger than 3 MB, ask your advisor for help on WhatsApp.
Find your latest property tax (predial) receipt.
Take a complete, clear photo (or upload the PDF if you paid online).
Upload it here.
Find your latest water bill.
Take a complete, clear photo (or upload the PDF of the digital bill).
Upload it here.
Find your latest electricity bill (CFE).
Take a complete, clear photo (or upload the PDF of the digital bill).
Upload it here.
Download from your online banking the cover page of your bank statement (the page with your name and CLABE).
You can cover the transactions: we only need the account holder, the bank and the CLABE.
Upload it here.

privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.intro: ACL Propiedades is responsible for processing your personal data in accordance with Mexico's Federal Law on Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties (LFPDPPP) and NOM-247-SE-2021.

sections.title: Data controller
sections.body: ACL Propiedades, located at Blvd. Independencia, Local 16, Plaza San Luciano, Torreón, Coahuila, is responsible for the use and protection of your personal data. You can reach us at inmobiliaria@aclpropiedades.com or by phone at 871 324 3271.

sections.title: Personal data we collect
sections.body: Through this site we collect the data you choose to share: name, email, phone or WhatsApp number and the content of your message, whether in the contact form, when requesting or scheduling a visit, when asking for an estimate of your property's value, when using the credit comparison tool, when downloading the buyer's guide or when subscribing to alerts for new listings or price drops. You may also chat with our virtual assistant (see the corresponding section) and, only if you accept, we measure site usage with Google Analytics. If you later start a purchase, sale, rental or advisory process with one of our advisors, we may ask for additional data needed for that process; that data is collected directly by the advisor, not through this website, unless you use the document portal described below.

sections.title: Purposes of processing
sections.body: We use your data to respond to your inquiries, contact you about properties of interest, and provide real estate advisory services. Additionally and optionally, we may use it to inform you about new properties or promotions; you may object to this secondary use at any time without affecting the handling of your original request.

sections.title: Data transfers
sections.body: We do not sell your personal data. To operate this site we rely on providers that process data on behalf of ACL Propiedades and only for that purpose: site hosting and database (Vercel and Supabase), email delivery (Resend), WhatsApp messages (Meta), the virtual assistant (Anthropic) and, if you accept, usage measurement (Google Analytics). Some of these providers may store or process information on servers located outside Mexico. Beyond those cases, we only share your data with third parties when necessary to comply with a legal obligation or a request from a competent authority.

sections.title: ARCO rights
sections.body: You have the right to Access, Rectify, and Cancel your personal data, as well as to Object to its use (ARCO rights). To exercise them, write to us at inmobiliaria@aclpropiedades.com stating your name and your request; we will respond within a reasonable time as required by the LFPDPPP.

sections.title: Cookies and tracking technologies
sections.body: We use Google Analytics to understand how the site is used (pages visited, time on site, traffic source) only if you accept it in the cookie notice shown when you arrive; if you decline, it is not loaded. You can change your decision at any time from "Cookie preferences" at the bottom of the page. If you accept, some of your browsing information is shared with Google. We do not use advertising cookies or sell your browsing information to third parties. We also use your browser's local storage to remember your preferences (language, appearance, favorites, viewed properties) and an anonymous identifier to count how many people viewed a listing. Google Maps (for example, on the Contact page) only loads when you click "Show map"; property maps use OpenStreetMap tiles, which receive your IP address when they load.

sections.title: Document portal (Tax Certificate and Birth Certificate)
sections.body: If you use our document portal (/documentos/<link>) to upload your Tax Status Certificate or your Birth Certificate, we process the data contained in those documents (RFC, CURP, name, tax address, date of birth) solely for the transaction your advisor shared the link for. Files are stored encrypted in private storage, only authorized ACL Propiedades staff can view them through signed, time-limited links, and we never ask for or store your SAT password, e.firma, or CIEC — you download those documents directly from the corresponding official site. We keep these documents while your transaction is active and afterward under ACL Propiedades' current retention policy; you may request their early deletion by exercising your ARCO rights.

sections.title: Virtual assistant (chat)
sections.body: The site's chat is an artificial intelligence assistant: the text you type is sent to an external provider (Anthropic) to generate the reply, and no person reads it at that moment. Do not enter sensitive data in it (passwords, bank details, CURP, etc.). If you share your name and phone or email so an advisor can contact you, we store them as an ACL Propiedades lead. The conversation is kept only in your browser while the tab is open; on our server we only record that a query was made (without its content and with an encrypted fingerprint of your IP address) to limit abuse, and that record is deleted after a week.

sections.title: Electronic document signing
sections.body: If you sign a document through an ACL Propiedades signing link, we store your name, your signature stroke, the date and time, the IP address you sign from and a digital fingerprint (hash) of the document, so we can show that what was signed is the same document you reviewed. We keep the document sent for signing, with its signature and fingerprint, for 6 months; after that it is deleted from our systems (keep your own copy).

sections.title: How long we keep your data
sections.body: Messages you send through the contact form are kept for 1 week. Your data as a prospect (name, phone, email and the follow-up of your inquiry) is kept for 1 month from the last time we were in contact; if a follow-up with you is scheduled, from that date. Documents sent for signing are kept for 6 months. If you register as a client, the documents in your file are kept for 3 years from the last activity with you and then deleted. You can ask us to delete your data sooner by exercising your ARCO rights.

sections.title: Changes to this notice
sections.body: Any changes to this Privacy Notice will be published on this same page.

rights.title: Consumer Rights Notice
rights.intro: In every residential real estate transaction, ACL Propiedades commits to acting in accordance with the Federal Consumer Protection Law (LFPC), its Regulations, and NOM-247-SE-2021, and accordingly recognizes that, as a consumer, you have the following rights:
items: To receive truthful, clear, and up-to-date information and advertising about the properties offered, regardless of the medium used —including digital media—, so that you can make the best purchase decision knowing the property's actual characteristics.

To know the property's characteristics, including: lot size, built area, type of structure, installations, finishes, accessories, parking space, common-use areas, available services, and the property's overall physical condition.
To freely choose the property that best fits your needs and purchasing capacity.
To not make any payment until the contractual relationship is documented in writing, except for deposits and operating expenses, as provided by the LFPC.

To sign a standard-form contract based on the model registered with the Federal Consumer Protection Agency (PROFECO), stating the terms and conditions of the sale. After signing, the provider must give you a copy of the signed contract.
To acquire a property that meets the safety and quality standards set by applicable regulations and reflected in the information and advertising you received.
To receive the property within the timeframe and conditions agreed in the corresponding contract.
Where applicable, to exercise the warranties on real estate provided by the LFPC, per the specifications of the corresponding contract.

To receive the corresponding compensation under the LFPC if, after the warranty is exercised, defects or faults persist in the property; as well as to have the necessary repairs made, or to choose to have the property replaced or the contract rescinded when applicable.
To have free and accessible channels for inquiries, requests, complaints, and suggestions, and to know the address the provider has designated to receive notifications.
To receive protection from the competent authorities under applicable law, including the right to file complaints and claims with them.

To have a Privacy Notice available explaining how your personal data will be handled and to consent to it where applicable, as well as to know the available means to exercise your rights of Access, Rectification, Cancellation, and Objection.

To receive treatment free of discrimination, without being denied or conditioned service or the sale of a home based on gender, nationality, ethnic origin, sexual orientation, religion, or any other characteristic, as provided by applicable law.
To freely choose the notary public for the deed-signing process.
rights.footnote: Based on Appendix A of NOM-247-SE-2021 and the Federal Consumer Protection Law.

prospects.title: Prospects
prospects.body: Each interested person is a card you drag from one stage to another. Log every contact so the follow-up date is worked out.

help.title: Questions?

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
points: Press “G” and then a letter to jump to a screen: G D dashboard, G H My day, G P Prospects, G C Clients, G A Agenda, G M Messages, G O properties.
“/” opens the global search from any screen.
Shortcuts are off while you type in a field.

myDay.title: My day
points: It gathers today: appointments in time order, unattended prospects, overdue follow-ups and today's.
“Today's route” opens Google Maps with your remaining visits as stops.
“New properties for your prospects” shows what was published this week that fits someone; you decide whether to tell them.
Holds and exclusives about to expire, your commissions and the team's monthly board also show up here.

prospects.title: Prospects
points: Drag the card to another column to change its stage (on a phone, use “More”).
“Log contact” saves the channel and a note and sets the next follow-up; you can dictate the note with the microphone.
The hot/warm/cold chip explains with points why a prospect is hot or cold; hover to see it.
“My views” saves your usual filters (on this device) so you can return to them with one tap.
If two prospects are the same person (same phone or email), open one and use “Merge into this one”: it keeps the whole history.

agenda.title: Agenda
points: Switch between month, week, day and list with the buttons on top; in week and day, appointments sit at their hour.
A visit request without an advisor is seen by the whole team: whoever takes it first keeps it.
At the bottom you can create the secret address to see your agenda in Google, Apple or Outlook. It is read-only: what you change there does not reach the panel.

properties.title: Properties
points: The “Listing N%” bar says what is missing (photos, description, location…); “Incomplete listings only” filters the pending ones.
“Duplicate” creates an inactive copy without photos so you can enter a similar one faster.
Select several rows to change price (capped at 50% at a time) or advisor for all of them at once; you are asked to confirm.
“Offers & hold” stores offers and the hold (one active per property); “Contract” stores whether it is exclusive and when it expires.
Listings with no visits, appointments or changes in 30 days are flagged “No activity” (office only).

visits.title: Visits
points: Log each visit to feed the report given to the owner.
When you mark a visit booked from the site as “Done”, the client gets a survey and their opinion shows in your Agenda.

commissions.title: Commissions
points: Each saved settlement works out the listing and sale commission of each advisor.
“Register” saves the amount as of that moment; later it is marked paid with its date.
Only the partners see all of them; each advisor sees their own in My day.

roles.title: Roles and access
points: A role groups the sections that can be seen; an access links an email to a role (and to an advisor).
When granting new access you can send an email invitation: the person chooses their password with the link and the account does not have to be created by hand.
“Invite” in the table sends the invitation again.

points: Forgot your password? On the sign-in page use “Forgot your password?”: you get a link to choose a new one.
The “Show” button next to the password lets you see what you type (handy on a phone).
Language and light or dark mode are changed at the top right.
